issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְגַם אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ' means 'And you also know' — the Chinese '你也知道' is correct. However, 'בֶן יֶתֶר' is a proper name 'son of Jether' (יֶתֶר), but the Chinese renders it as '餘剩物的兒子' ('son of the remnant/leftover'), which is a mistranslation of the proper name 'Jether' as a common noun. This changes the identity of Amasa's father.
